question: Which L9 heads carry the part of the fixed two-term MLP4 write not explained by H1/H4?
population: The same 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows.

operator.hybrid: Add the fixed two-term MLP4 response at resid5 on last+period+the and capture the resulting L9 head outputs.
operator.head_intervention: At the final-subject query in an otherwise native base run, replace selected complete L9 preprojection head outputs by the writer-hybrid outputs.
operator.arms: writer; all nine heads; H1/H4 pair; every one of nine singleton heads; every one of nine leave-one-out complements
operator.attribution: For each head report singleton recovery, full-minus-leave-one-out recovery, and their fixed equal-weight endpoint average. This is an endpoint attribution, not a Shapley claim.

predictions.pred_a_exact_instrument: The empty writer hook is exactly inert, writer algebra closes within 2e-3, native/manual attention closes within 1e-4, and selecting all nine hybrid heads equals the direct complete hybrid L9 preprojection replacement within 0.125 scored logit.
predictions.pred_b_writer_and_h1h4_recurrence: The writer and H1/H4 complete arms each recur within 0.02 of 0.33379277118533013 and 0.13009089135863688, respectively, with positive A1/A2 recovery and direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_c_all_head_mediation: All nine L9 heads retain at least 50% of the writer mean recovery and have positive A1/A2 recovery with direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_d_additional_head: At least one head outside H1/H4 has endpoint attribution at least 0.03, positive singleton recovery in A1/A2, and a positive full-minus-leave-one-out drop in A1/A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All 21 arms produce all 64 finite outcomes within 50 model forward calls and 1600 example evaluations.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license the reported additional head(s) as candidates carrying the MLP4-induced route beyond H1/H4.
terminal.null: The run is valid but C or D fails: the missing writer effect is not attributable to an additional direct L9 final-query head under this sweep.
terminal.invalid: Instrument identity, recurrence, native capability, alignment, finiteness, or coverage fails. No head, arm, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First fixed singleton-plus-leave-one-out sweep of all L9 heads for a specific upstream factorized MLP-induced signal.
